'''Ma'ar Shaddam''' was a remote [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], home to the armorers who served [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. The planet was settled by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Master Weaponsmith]]s not only for the quality of its ore, but because its remoteness made it difficult for the authorities to police the sale of illegal weaponry.

[[Firmus Kett]]'s family had investments on Ma'ar Shaddam.<ref name="EGW-cut6" />
